payload.title: File per-batch email labeling annotations for ghost and saleor
payload.description:
After the scopes and batches are accepted, file one `annotation` issue per batch under this epic, using the template below. These are the issues small-model agents work.

## Template

Title: `Label email mentions: <repo> batch <n>`
Type: `annotation`. Label: `model:small`.
Description:

```
Label every email candidate line in these files of <repo> at its pinned commit.

Files:
- <path>
- ...

Read first, in full:
.agents/skills/curate-scanner-evaluation-corpus/references/mention-attribute-labeling.md
and its worked example packet.

Input: the entries for these files in
tests/benchmark/repos/<repo>/annotations/packets/email-candidates.yaml

Write exactly one record per candidate line to
tests/benchmark/repos/<repo>/annotations/packets/<this-issue-id>.yaml
with review_state: proposed.

Rules:
- Do not run the scanner or read scanner output.
- Uncertain: status ambiguous with a one-sentence rationale. Do not guess.
- Do not edit any other file.

Finish: run the packet validator on your file. When it passes, record the pass in
annotations/<this-issue-id>/pass.md and move this issue to awaiting-review.
```

## Done when

Every accepted batch has an `annotation` issue.
